## About
We're a full service automotive maintenance and performance facility on West 14th Street in Covington. If it involves high-performance cars, speed, custom modifications, fabrication, protection or racing, it's in our wheelhouse.
Every car that hits our shop floor gets treated the same. It's a project with long-term success as the goal, and it gets our undivided attention from the first write-up to the finished car. We also run a full service print shop in-house for liveries, fleet graphics and wraps.
Don't build blindly. Tell us what you're after and we'll come up with a gameplan together. We're rated 4.9 from 212 Google reviews.

## Services
- Performance Upgrades and Installs: Cold air intakes and cat-back exhaust installs, all the way up to full kill-mode engine builds.
- Maintenance and service: Service and maintenance for your high end car, without the dealership runaround.
- Paint protection film and ceramic coating: PPF, ceramic coatings and paint corrections for your daily driver, weekend warrior or full livery racecar.
- Custom Fabrication: Modified and full exhaust systems, intake systems, certified roll cages and safety components. TIG and MIG.
- Liveries - fleet - wrap: Design, print and application done in-house for racecar liveries, fleet graphics and general print needs.
- All things racing: Racecar build and prep, trackside support and coaching, arrive and drive experiences, and private track day rentals.
- Window tint and vinyl accents: Reviewers mention window tint, chrome blackout in gloss black vinyl and vinyl accents done here.

## FAQ
Q: When is the shop open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Saturday and Sunday we're closed.

Q: How should I get in touch?
A: However you like. Call or text, email, DM us on social, stop in the shop or find us at a race. Just reach out.

Q: Do I need my own racecar to race with you?
A: No. We can prep and support your car, or put you in our racecars at endurance races.

Q: Is this only for track cars?
A: Not at all. Whether it's your daily driver, weekend warrior or full livery racecar, we'll take care of it.

## What customers say
- "Took my new Land Cruiser to Level 3 to get full body PPF, ceramic coating, window tint and some vinyl accents. Daniel was great to work with, excellent communication, knowledgeable and ensures customer satisfaction. There was a bit of a miscommunication with the team and they forgot to PPF the full roof of the vehicle. It took an extra day for them to complete the job, but overall very little hassle. The quality of the PPF application is excellent, you have to know where to look in order find the edges of the PPF. It's practically invisible.

I've had similar work done on previous vehicles at other shops and this is the first show that has insisted on a follow up visits after a week or so to give the car a look over to double check the quality of the installation. The pride they take in their work clearly shows. In a day and age where so many business try to get you in and out as quick as they can its refreshing to work with a business that puts quality above all else." (Jay Wahlbrink, 5/5)
